_what_this_is: The hand-written declaration the pinned codon tables are derived from. prepare_tables.py reads it, reads the two records it names, and writes codon_tables.json. Nothing in codon_tables.json is typed by hand: edit this file and regenerate.

ecoli_bl21.design_window_basis: A synthesis vendor's declared acceptance window for this host, not a measurement of the genome. It is checked against the record: the pinned genome's own GC fraction must fall inside gc_global, or the table refuses to build.
ecoli_bl21.label: Escherichia coli BL21(DE3)
ecoli_bl21.license: public domain / no restrictions on use (INSDC)
ecoli_bl21.source: GenBank record for the Escherichia coli BL21(DE3) complete genome, fetched as rettype=gbwithparts

streptomyces_coelicolor.design_window_basis: A synthesis vendor's declared acceptance window for this host, not a measurement of the genome. It is checked against the record: the pinned genome's own GC fraction must fall inside gc_global, or the table refuses to build.
streptomyces_coelicolor.label: Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2)
streptomyces_coelicolor.license: public domain / no restrictions on use (INSDC)
streptomyces_coelicolor.source: GenBank record for the Streptomyces coelicolor A3(2) chromosome. The same file is shipped as the input of campaigns/bgcdetect-scoelicolor-01, so this host's table is recomputable from the repository alone.

reference_set.rule: Every CDS feature of the record whose /product matches product_pattern (case-insensitive), that is not /pseudo, whose location is a single contiguous range, whose /codon_start is 1 and /transl_table is 11, whose extracted bases are a whole number of ACGT codons ending in exactly one stop, and whose translation under the standard code equals the record's own /translation. Relative adaptiveness is then count / max(count in the synonymous family), over all codons of those genes including each terminal stop, with an unobserved codon given `pseudocount` observations first (Sharp & Li 1987, Nucleic Acids Res 15:1281).
reference_set.why_ribosomal: CAI needs a reference set of genes under strong translational selection, and the ribosomal proteins are the set every host has, annotated under a name that can be matched mechanically. The alternative -- a genome-wide table -- measures mutational bias as much as selection, which is what the pinned weights are supposed to distinguish.
